newsitem.title: USA: MEMC annual revenues may top $1 bln - NYT.
newsitem.headline: MEMC annual revenues may top $1 bln - NYT.

text.p: MEMC Electronic Materials Inc is expected to release full-year results showing revenues at the Missouri-based company topping $1 billion for the first time, the New York Times said on Monday.
MEMC, which makes silicon wafers, is to report results after the stock market closes Monday, the paper said.
The report said a J.P. Morgan & Co analyst upgraded MEMC to a "buy" Friday on the belief that MEMC's part of the chip industry is rebounding.
MEMC Electronic said in October that it might post a fourth quarter loss and sales of about $200 million.
Wall Street is expecting the company to report a fourth quarter loss of $0.22 per share and earnings of $2.38 per share for the full year, according to First Call estimates.
